  r1(t) = [1117364667048, 9201889102365]

  P_(j+1) = r1*P_j - c*P_(j-1)  for j>=1.

  h(t) = [2378504184704, 15929790332245, 3238463497124, 8366655218701, 2009248981723, 8631431980006, 10890619060192, 292443175931, 10323456111093, 7982013111025, 650771514753, 10855416848659, 8764675658287, 10252756817779, 3585535975087, 1].

  R = F_p[t,x] / (h(t)*x)
with deg(t)=0 and deg(x)=1, and let I=(x). Its p-th Frobenius power is
I^[p]=(x^p). The polynomial h is squarefree and splits into exactly m distinct
monic linear factors tau_i(t). If h=product_i tau_i, then
